This '''Human Sith''' was one of five members of the [[One Sith]] who [[Ambush on Daluuj|ambushed]] a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]] in [[137 ABY]]. He [[Death/Legends|killed]] a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Jedi before being struck down by [[Wolf Sazen]] and [[Shado Vao]].
